logic.entry: Buy at first OOS executable 1m open, without a signal.
logic.exit: Hold to common OOS terminal execution and liquidate at cost.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT unlevered long-only spot comparator.

sources.citation: De Nicola, G. (2021). On the Intraday Behavior of Bitcoin. Ledger, 6. DOI:10.5195/ledger.2021.213.
sources.reported_finding: The paper reports significant negative first-order autocorrelation on 1h, 2h and 4h returns and stronger percentage reversals after larger moves. It uses historical BTC data; this batch separately tests Binance BTC/ETH under explicit current cost assumptions.
